INSERT INTO
            bingo_entries (game_id, number, text, normalized_text)
        VALUES
            (
                ?,
                (
                    SELECT
                        COALESCE(MAX(number), 0) + 1
                    FROM
                        bingo_entries
                    WHERE
                        game_id = ?
                ),
                ?,
                ?
            ) ON CONFLICT(game_id, normalized_text) DO
        UPDATE
        SET
            text = excluded.text,
            active = 1
        RETURNING
            id,
            number
